description: This file defines the SubstitutionStrategy interface for placeholder substitution strategies applied to command headers in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes method signatures for checking applicability and applying substitutions, and it is parameterized by a type extending WithDittoHeaders.

classes.name: SubstitutionStrategy
classes.description: An interface defining a strategy for placeholder substitution on headers of a command of type T, which extends WithDittoHeaders.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks whether the substitution strategy is applicable to the provided WithDittoHeaders instance.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Applies placeholder substitution on the provided WithDittoHeaders using the specified HeaderBasedPlaceholderSubstitutionAlgorithm.
